build_DREAM_dataset: run the build function to download and set up the DREAM dataset into the datapath directory
review_build_function: review the build function that downloads train, test, and dev JSON files for the DREAM dataset
summarize_RESOURCES: summarize the RESOURCES list containing three DownloadableFile entries for the DREAM dataset splits
test_build_function: test the build function to verify it correctly downloads and marks the DREAM dataset as built
refactor_build_function: refactor the build function to support additional dataset splits or alternative download sources
